_templateNotes: Copy this file to a new label file such as pulldown_001.json, then edit the paths, split, expectedReps, and reps.
Use issueIds from availableIssues. Use an empty issueIds array for a clean rep.
Files named _template.json or *.template.json are ignored by dataset:evaluate and dataset:optimize.

reps.notes: Clean rep or describe the visible form issue.

notes: Draft label template. Copy to a real label file, review timings/issues, then set reviewStatus to reviewed.

availableIssues.feedbackMessage: Pull deeper — bring the bar to your upper chest.
Extend fully — reach all the way up at the top.
Stay upright — avoid leaning back excessively.
Slow down the pull — control the descent.
Control the return — resist the weight on the way up.
